f.title: Manage and transmit ICSRs in line with GVP Module VI (current version)
f.statement: From 22 November 2017, irrespective of the authorisation procedure, marketing authorisation holders must, in managing and transmitting individual case safety reports (ICSRs) for all serious and non-serious adverse reactions occurring in the EEA and brought to their attention by a healthcare professional or patient, comply with the relevant EU recommendations in the Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices Module VI (management and reporting of adverse reactions to medicinal products), current version, published on the EMA website.
f.legal_basis: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; Directive 2001/83/EC; Law 95/2006 Title XVIII
f.applicability: All serious and non-serious adverse reactions occurring in the EEA and notified to the MAH by a healthcare professional or patient
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: în gestionarea și transmiterea rapoartelor individuale ale cazurilor privind siguranța (Individual Case Safety Reports = ICSRs), deținătorii autorizație de punere pe piață trebuie să respecte recomandările UE relevante conform Ghidului de bune practici de farmacovigilență - Modulul VI Gestionarea și raportarea reacțiilor adverse la medicamentele de uz uman, versiunea în vigoare, publicat pe website-ul Agenției Europene a Medicamentului (EMA).

f.title: Submit serious ICSRs from Romania to EudraVigilance (EVHUMAN) within 15 days
f.statement: Serious adverse reactions (serious ICSRs) reported from the territory of Romania must be transmitted by the marketing authorisation holder directly to the EMA EudraVigilance database (Post-Authorisation Module, Message/Batch Receiver Identifier: EVHUMAN) within 15 days of the date of receipt of the reports.

f.title: Transmit ICSRs to EudraVigilance electronically in ICH E2B(R2) or E2B(R3) format
f.statement: Transmission of ICSRs to the EudraVigilance database is made electronically, in ICH E2B(R2) or ICH E2B(R3) format.

f.title: Retrieve Romanian ICSRs from EudraVigilance: ANMDM no longer forwards them to MAHs
f.statement: From 22 November 2017 marketing authorisation holders no longer receive adverse reaction reports directly from the National Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices (ANMDM); these reports are made available to MAHs by EMA through the EudraVigilance system in ICH E2B(R3) format.
f.applicability: Romanian adverse reaction reports received by ANMDM
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; E2B / transmission; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Începând cu data de 22 noiembrie 2017, DAPP nu mai primesc reacțiile adverse în mod direct de la Agenția Națională a Medicamentului și a Dispozitivelor Medicale (ANMDM). Acestea sunt puse la dispoziția DAPP de către EMA prin intermediul sistemului EudraVigilance, în format ICH E2B (R3).
rows.review_note: Review: the passage describes the channel change rather than using a modal verb; the statement keeps the source's descriptive wording and adds no duty beyond it (the title names the practical consequence for intake). Double-check: held below 90 because the level rests on the binding character of the communication, not an explicit modal.
rows.quote_en: Starting from 22 November 2017, MAHs no longer receive adverse reactions directly from the National Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices (ANMDM). These are made available to MAHs by EMA through the EudraVigilance system, in ICH E2B (R3) format.

f.title: Previous ANMDM national ICSR electronic transmission requirements repealed
f.statement: This communication repeals all previous provisions on ANMDM requirements for electronic transmission of ICSRs; the present provisions apply from 22 November 2017.

rows.quote: Prin prezenta comunicare se abrogă toate prevederile anterioare referitoare la cerințele ANMDM de transmitere electronică a ICSR. Actualele prevederi sunt în vigoare începând cu data de 22 noiembrie 2017.
